verified: Verified: this result is signed by your lab.
carrier_intro: You carry a change in these genes. This usually does not mean you are ill.
none: No carrier changes were found in the panel.
notyet: Not quite. Read the card again if you like.
pair_help: Do this together, in person. You will both learn only one thing: whether you share a change in the same gene. Your results never leave your phones.
qr: Ask your partner to scan this code (valid 5 minutes, one use)
shared_yes: You share a change in the same gene.
shared_no: You do not share a change in the same gene.
reveal_info: Nothing is shown until both of you agree.
waiting: Waiting for your partner to agree.
none_perm: Nothing is shared. This is the default.
delete: Withdraw all permissions and delete my data from this phone
options: Your options are yours to choose, including continuing without any intervention.
scan_ok: Code read. Continue to the check.
scan_bad: That is not an AMANA pairing code.
scan_denied: Camera not available. Use the code shown on your partner's phone instead.
set_pin: Set app lock PIN (at least 4 digits)
lock_on: App lock is on. Your saved result is encrypted on this phone.
offline_copy: No connection. Showing the encrypted copy saved on this phone.
signin: Sign in with national digital ID (demo)
signin_note: Demo sign-in with a synthetic persona. Your result is then sent once to this phone and kept here, encrypted.
switch: Use a different demo persona (deletes this phone's copy)
only_you: Only you can see this. It is stored on this phone, not on our servers.
not_verified: The signatures on this result did not check out. Do not rely on it.
no_wallet: There is no result on this phone yet. Sign in first.
waiting_partner: Waiting for your partner to connect...
partner_agreed: Your partner has agreed to see the condition.
check_failed: The check could not be completed. Start again with a new code.
